channel.title: The Radar: what is shooting in Australia, New Zealand and Southeast Asia
channel.description: Changes to the production map, checked every week. Every pin links to its public sources.

item.title: The Radar, 20 November 2026
item.description: Added Queenstown (Netflix, New Zealand). Also on now, each with one public source so far and marked as such: McLeod's Daughters (regional Victoria), Chan and You've Changed (Auckland), and an untitled FX pilot (Bangkok). On the map now: 12 productions, 8 shooting and 4 in pre-production.

item.title: The Radar, 19 November 2026
item.description: Map rebuilt: seven productions, each with two or three public sources. On the map now: 7 productions, 5 shooting and 2 in pre-production.
